invariants: Workload is frozen to the 'interactive' row of workloads.json: batch=1, prompt_tokens=256, new_tokens=32; input ids are the chat-templated workloads.json prompt tokenized with add_special_tokens=False (enable_thinking=False, add_generation_prompt=True) replicated by whole-prompt repetition and truncated to exactly 256 tokens, placed on the bound device as an int64 tensor of shape [1,256].

Model is Qwen3ForCausalLM loaded from the request assets directory with dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation='sdpa', local_files_only=True, moved to context['device'] and kept in eval mode; weights are never mutated.

Generation is greedy: each step takes argmax of output.logits[:, -1] with keepdim=True; exactly 32 tokens are produced (1 prefill token + 31 decode steps) with EOS early stopping disabled by the explicit loop, and past_key_values are threaded through every decode step with use_cache=True and logits_to_keep=1.

The measured invocation preserves the full generation workload: the 31 cached decode steps remain inside run(); the generated_tokens_per_second objective targets the full request, i.e. the whole window from the leading synchronize through prefill, the first argmax and all 31 decode steps to the final torch.cuda.synchronize (qwen_inference.py:34), while the source's explicit first-token-ready synchronize after the first argmax (qwen_inference.py:23) is retained unchanged inside the same invocation and still delimits the reported ttft_ms phase, but is no longer the objective boundary.

Numerical policy matches the source: seed 20261020, torch.set_num_threads(4), set_num_interop_threads(1), TF32 disabled for cuda.matmul and cudnn, cudnn.benchmark False, float32_matmul_precision 'highest'; run executes under torch.inference_mode.

Correctness observations in quality mode are the full per-step last-position logits (stacked to [1,32,vocab]) and the full greedy token sequence [1,32]; the framework compares logits within logits_atol=logits_rtol=0.02 (mirrored by atol/rtol) and requires torch.equal greedy tokens; the +1-corruption negative control of common.negative_check must be rejected; no accuracy or convergence claim beyond this reference fidelity.
Single-process single-GPU task on context['device']: no collectives, no process-group creation or destruction in the adapter, no second reference model allocated.
Measure/profile modes keep the source's clean non-capture timing path (no logit retention), and execution semantics plus total work amount are identical across modes.

The objective is generated_tokens_per_second in tokens/s with direction maximize, per request.json: full-request generated-token throughput of the interactive workload, computed exactly as the source emits it (qwen_inference.py:40) and the frozen adapter reports it (adapter.py:184), batch * new_tokens * 1e9 / (end - start), i.e. the 32 greedy tokens of the preserved generation length divided by the total prefill+decode wall time of one infer() invocation with batch=1 and new_tokens=32; objective.constraints is empty, and the workload row's own goals (ttft min on ttft_ms, decode max on decode_tokens_per_second) are separate objectives, not constraints on this one.

The frozen evaluator already supports this objective unchanged: adapter.py run() (adapter.py:115-160) executes the identical full infer() body with the source's perf_counter_ns phase timestamps, and metrics() (adapter.py:172-194) derives generated_tokens_per_second from the same internal start/end boundaries together with ttft_ms, decode_ms, end_to_end_ms, decode_tokens_per_second, wall_elapsed_ms and peak_allocated_bytes; the goal change is contract-only, requiring no adapter, measurement-path, numerical or accuracy change.

State protocol matches the frozen adapter: prepare(context, request) applies the source numerical policy, loads the tokenizer and Qwen3ForCausalLM from request['assets']['assets'] onto context['device'] in eval mode, and builds the frozen [1,256] input; reset(state) reseeds torch to 20261020, restores eval mode and drops stored results; the KV cache is created fresh inside run(), so inference is stateless across warmup and repeats; set_mode toggles only quality-mode logit capture and changes no execution semantics; models(state) returns {'model': state['model']}.
